headline: ¿Por qué no miran al consumidor primero?

headline: Opinion Economista de Manpower Consult Johnny Campana
content: Recentemente, el economista de Ree y tres colegas  you published a study (Double for Nothing? Experimental Evidence on an Unconditional Teachers Salary Increase in Indonesia) thats shows the results of evaluating a certification teacher program in Indonesia initiated in 2005. The program aimed at doubling their salary after ten years those teachers who fulfilled some minimum academic requirements (such as having university degree or equivalent), passed external knowledge evaluations and demonstrated adequate pedagogical practices. Those who did not manage to reach these standards could undergo a year training to improve their skills and submit themselves again to the assessments... In the last decade, being a teaching career was not particularly disadvantageous in the Asian country. For example, average teacher salaries were located in the income distribution percentile 50 among professionals. However,the program managed to further improve these conditions allowing salaries to rise up to the percentile 90. The evaluation yielded surprising outcomes. On one hand, while the program succeeded increasing job satisfaction regarding earnings, reducing financial worries and minimizing need for second jobs, three years later there wasn’t any effect on student learning indicators. That means students’ performance under teachers whose wages increased didn’t significantly improved compared to students taught by instructors maintaining initial wage levels through third year. Therefore authors conclude unconditional pay raise may prove ineffective policy alternative improving productivity measures.

Propuesta sugiere modificación constitucional para establecer nueva Superintendencia de Entidades Solidarias enfocada exclusivamente en cooperativas, fundaciones comunales y asociaciones mutualistas. Las cooperativas... difieren jurídicamente de instituciones financieras usualmente supervisadas por SBS, argumenta.
